item.title: SAISD Board to Vote on Mandatory Daily Prayer Period
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The San Angelo Independent School District Board of Trustees will hold a regular meeting at 5:45 p.m. today in the board room of the administration building at 1621 University Ave. Learn More Here.

item.title: Crash on US 87 Sends at Least 1 to Hospital
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — At least one person was taken to the hospital Monday morning after a crash on US Highway 87 just north of San Angelo.The crash occurred about 11:40 a.m. at the intersection of US 87 and FM 2105, which has long been one of the most dangerous sites for collisions in Tom Green County. Learn More Here.

item.title: Texas CBP Officers Seize Over $6.8M in Cocaine, More Than 190,000 Lethal Doses
item.description: LAREDO, TX — U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Office of Field Operations officers at the Laredo Port of Entry seized cocaine that totaled over $6,800,000 in street value.The seizure occurred on Tuesday, Feb. 10, at the World Trade Bridge, when a CBP officer referred a 2018 T3 International tractor and trailer manifesting a shipment of “roses/fresh flowers” for secondary inspection. item.title: Angelo State's Majik Esquivel Named LSC Offensive Player of the Week
item.description: RICHARDSON, TX — Angelo State guard Majik Esquivel has been named the Lone Star Conference Offensive Player of the Week after helping the Rambelles extend their winning streak with a pair of road victories.Esquivel, a sophomore from Lubbock, averaged 21.5 points per game while shooting 51.7% from the field. The honor marks the second time this season she has received the weekly award. Learn More Here.

item.title: Paxton Launches Investigations Into Texas School Districts Over Student Protests
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has launched investigations into three school districts over student protests against immigration enforcement, alleging that school officials failed to ensure student safety and minimize classroom disruptions. Learn More Here.

item.title: LIVE! Daily News | Biker Arrested After DPS Pursuit
item.description: Today on LIVE!, a biker was arrested last night, early voting starts tomorrow, and it's playoff time for the girls in basketball. For our interview, Kaitlyn Brosh with Howard College is in studio to talk to James Bouligny.Today's stories: Learn More Here.

item.title: Grape Creek's Gabe Santillan Commits to Texas Wesleyan
item.description: GRAPE CREEK, TX — Grape Creek standout safety Gabe Santillan recently announced that he has committed to play college football at Texas Wesleyan University.The young man made the announcement on his X account on Feb. 7. Learn More Here.

item.title: Ozona Girls Top Ballinger in Playoff Opener for McSherry’s 700th Win
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Ozona Lady Lions had to celebrate with two banners after their 40-29 win over Ballinger on Monday.One was for their bi-district playoff win, and the other was for head coach Jerry McSherry’s 700th career victory. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 13 Garden City Dominates Bi-District Round
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A dominant defensive performance saw the No. 13 Garden City Lady Kats race past Eden in the first round of the playoffs on Monday night. Garden City led from start to finish to claim a bi-district championship, 52-13. Learn More Here.

item.title: Christoval Girls Blitz Coleman for Bi-District Playoff Win
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Christoval Lady Cougars wanted to impose their defensive will on Coleman in their first-round playoff game Monday.With 16 steals in the first half, it’s safe to say they accomplished that goal. Learn More Here.
